History.metaDescription: Historical chronology, neighborhoods, Lisi i Kungullarit, and documented sources for the village of Topanicë.
History.pageDescription: A narrative built on documented records and the living memory of residents.
History.timelineEmpty: Historical notes will be added once documented with sources.
History.quartersUpperP1: An interview with the Topanica Association mentions “Lagjja e Epërme” (Upper Quarter), linked to families who arrived from the highlands of Kamenicë (Malësia e Kamenicës). The names and boundaries of other quarters (mëhallët) will be added as they are documented with residents.
History.quartersUpperP2: Write to us with the name of your quarter, a memory tied to it, and who might help complete the story.
History.quartersCitation: Source: SAM24.info, Topanica Association Interview, 30 May 2025
History.quartersContributeLink: Share a story about your neighborhood
History.oakImageAlt: Emblem of Lisi i Kungullarit in the logo of the Topanica Association
History.oakBody: The solitary oak tree featured in the logo of the Topanica Association is known as “Lisi i Kungullarit”. In a 2025 interview, the association chair describes it as an oak over 100 years old, standing alone with no other trees nearby. Its age is passed down as community lore rather than a scientific measurement.
History.institutionsNote: Names and histories here can be expanded by residents.
History.schoolBody: The primary and lower secondary school is named SHFMU “Rexhep Mala”. In the Central Election Commission’s (KQZ) archival polling center list of 2014, the school in Topanicë appears under the spelling “Rexhep Malaj”.
History.mosqueBody: An important place in the life and memory of the community. Stories about its construction and history await documentation.
History.diasporaBody: Family ties with the diaspora are part of everyday village life. Share memories, photographs, and initiatives that connect generations and places.
